cohort: 42,379 women for the analysis of cesarean delivery on fecundability and 74,024 women for the analysis of fecundability on cesarean delivery
finding: Women with a previous cesarean delivery had lower fecundability and higher infertility risk, but women with lower fecundability were also more likely to have a cesarean delivery, suggesting a bidirectional relationship.
mod_finding: Women with a previous cesarean delivery had a higher risk of subsequent cesarean delivery.
